properties.project_name: 3E -- plan block east of Venue, toward 3rd St
properties.digitized_from: Owner-directed construction, not a hand trace: Venue's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge (72.07m, the edge facing 3rd St) extended east as a rectangle of the same length and orientation, widened until it reaches the real 3rd St curb line (src/street_geometry.py buffer, half-width 6.8m).
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had 3E absorbed into Venue -- 'the real building spans the plan's 3W/3E line as one development, not two'). The owner identified 3E as a separate real plan block east of Venue, initially pointing at real-gap-fragments 6+7 (a jagged sliver hugging a structure visible in satellite imagery between Venue and 3rd St). Construction went through two corrections from the owner: (1) an axis-aligned bounding box of fragments 6+7 wrongly cut across Venue's own diagonal orientation and overlapped neighboring land -- corrected by using Venue's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge as the shared border instead, matching its exact length (72.07m) and rotation, with depth set so the area matched fragments 6+7 (3,030 sqm); (2) the owner then directed widening the rectangle further east to the real 3rd St curb line rather than stopping at the fragment-matched depth, giving the final 4,682 sqm shown here.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (owner-directed construction: shares Venue's real east edge and orientation, widened to the real 3rd St curb line) not a hand trace or surveyed footprint. Esri satellite imagery shows what appears to be a real structure across much of this area (a roof pattern resembling built construction, not open land or a parking lot), but its name, address, and completion status are NOT confirmed by any source checked in this pass -- flagged here rather than guessed. status/use are carried over from the OCII plan designation (a residential block on the 3W/3E line, matching Venue), not independently confirmed for this specific structure.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 3E. East of Venue (1155 4th St / 3W), toward 3rd St. Previously assumed absorbed into Venue's own footprint; the owner's review found it real and separate.
